essence: The practitioner should worship Durgā in this gentle, three-eyed, jewel-adorned form
The practitioner should worship the obstacle-destroying deity crowned with a half-moon
The practitioner should next worship the three-eyed army-lord clothed in red
Outside are the four weapons and three elements in the two pathways
The practitioner should recite the mantra one hundred thousand times according to rule
